notes.title: Battlecore Robots – September Update for Patreon
notes.notes:
September's update just landed — New version of Battlecore Robots on Patreon!



September adds 8 new chips and 4 new mapas!



New Chips

Frenetic Chip

Spectral Chip

Hanzo's Echoes

Repulsor Chip

Charger Chip

Wildfist Chip

Watchdog Chip

Cooler Chip

New Maps

Training Arena Blue (Rework)

Ruins

Workzone

Spiky Platform



These new chips add greater customization capabilities, allowing you to alter stats without having to change the rest of your build. Do you love that Gun but wish it wouldn't overheat so quickly? There might be a chip for that!

And that's not all: we're also experimenting with 4 new maps (including a rework of Training Arena Blue) to refine the experience and deliver more fun and varied combat. We'll show you more soon!

Furthermore, we've added base game improvements:

Added Antialiasing (FAA)

Implemented improvements to the AI

Better shader loading performance

In the future, we will give you the option to change the type of Antialiasing you want to apply. In the meantime, we have implemented this visual improvement to make the wait more pleasant.


[previewyoutube="WA8oev9mxTU;full"][/previewyoutube]


THANK YOU SO MUCH for your support on Patreon. It means the world to us — it’s what keeps the project alive and growing.



If you’re enjoying Battlecore Robots and want to help build its future (and get early access to new versions, behind-the-scenes content, and more), consider joining our Patreon:

https://www.patreon.com/battlecorerobots



We’d love to hear your thoughts on the new content—share feedback, ideas, and epic plays in the comments or on our Discord.



See you in the Arena!



— The YellowFall Games team

notes.title: Battlecore Robots – July Patreon Update Released!
notes.notes:
July Update is LIVE — New Build for Battlecore Robots on Patreon!



This month’s update brings the heat with two brand-new Battlecores and four wild new weapons to try out! 



 New Battlecores 

KVDA – A punk-inspired powerhouse with a devastating Overdrive melee swing.

Slug – A fast, defensive bruiser that clears the battlefield with a shockwave Overdrive. 

New Weapons 

Curve-L

Curve-R

Curve Ilegal

Espiral 



Each weapon brings unique projectile behaviors and tactical possibilities — and each Battlecore comes with their own signature Overdrive ability to shake things up in the arena.
